body.name: workflow.advanceActions.freePass.isEnabled

body.name: workflow.advanceActions.freeReject.isEnabled
body.description: 当在工作流引擎的节点配置中开启了允许自由驳回，当前节点会显示"自由驳回"按钮，用户可选择驳回至指定节点

body.name: workflow.advanceActions.freeRecover.isEnabled
body.description: 当调用驳回接口时传入了 `isFreedomRecovery` 参数，当前节点会显示"选择下个节点"按钮，允许用户自由选择重入的节点，只能选择当前节点到驳回节点之间的节点（包括驳回节点），此功能应谨慎使用，因为可能会跳过某些节点，容易产生责任不清的情况

actions.script: if (event.data.validateResult.error){ event.stopPropagation();return; } let payload = event.data.validateResult.payload; let item = {name: payload.name, title: payload.title, ui: payload.ui, api: payload.api}; if (payload.icon !== undefined) { item.icon = payload.icon; } let items = context.props.data.allItems || []; if (items.find(i => i.name == item.name)) { context.props.env.notify('error', '已存在同名功能'); event.stopPropagation(); return; } if (context.props.data.modelFormatVersion === '2.0') { item.api = {isEnabled: false, httpMethod: 'POST', url: '', implementationMode: 'WEB_API'}; } event.setData({newCustomFunction: item});
var name = context.props.data.name; var items = context.props.data.custom; var finalItems = items.filter(item => item.name !== name); event.setData({items: finalItems});
